Hero.headline: Learn Together!!
Hero.description: A fun and engaging learning platform with your buddies P'Bit and Nong Brite. Start your learning adventure today!

Features.title: Courses
Features.description: Learn through 7 fun games, developing thinking and problem-solving skills.

0.title: What do you want to learn with P'Bit today?
0.description: Choose your favorite path and start your adventure with short, fun, and easy-to-understand foundational skill games.

1.title: Challenge yourself with mini-games?
1.description: Collect coins, earn points, and unlock new levels while practicing logic, math, and problem-solving skills.

2.title: Can I review anytime?
2.description: Review past lessons, brush up on areas where you lack confidence, and replay on any device, anytime.

Stats.title: Numbers That Tell a Story
Stats.description: Discover the impressive statistics of our learning platform.

Physics.title: Interactive Mascot Playground
Physics.description: Drag, toss, and play with our mascots! Click anywhere in the box to add more friends.

CTA.title: Ready to Start Your Adventure?
CTA.description: Join thousands of learners and begin your journey to fun learning.

path-navigation.title: Path Navigation
path-navigation.description: Draw a path to guide P'Bit through the grid to the correct destination. Develops logical thinking and systematic planning skills.

counting-classification.title: Counting & Classification
counting-classification.description: Find and count the hidden shapes based on given conditions. Enhances observation and classification skills.

conditional-matching.title: Conditional Matching
conditional-matching.description: Analyze the given conditions and select the matching item. Practices conditional logic and analytical thinking (If-Then).

sequencing.title: Sequencing
sequencing.description: Arrange the picture events in the correct chronological order. Learn about sequential processes and algorithmic thinking.

step-counting.title: Loop Patterns
step-counting.description: Select and loop ingredients to make a smoothie based on a recipe. Learn the fundamentals of loops in basic programming.

fruit-matching-grid.title: Fruit Matching Grid
fruit-matching-grid.description: Memorize the positions of fruits in the grid, then select the correct fruit to fill in the missing spots to test memory and observation skills.

grid-based-coloring.title: Grid-based Coloring
grid-based-coloring.description: Memorize and color the grid to match the original pattern. Enhances memory, spatial matching skills, and observation.
